title: Bird Feeder
description: Feed the Bird, Allay, Bee in your New Bird Feeder And Water Spender
body:
# **Bird Feeder**

Put out seed, water, and a little patience — and let your world fill with birds.

## Summary 
Place a bird feeder and a bird bath, fill them, and wild birds drop by to feed, sip, and bathe. Purely cozy — no farming, just a world that feels alive.

## Description 

Real life has a simple joy: you hang a feeder, and birds you'd never otherwise see come by to visit. **Bird Feeder** brings that to Minecraft.

Place a **Bird Feeder** and a **Bird Bath**, keep them stocked, and wild flyers will drift in on their own — land, feed or splash for a few seconds, and go on their way. Nothing is bred. Nothing is farmed. There's no counter to optimise. It's just a quiet bit of life that makes a base, a garden, or a porch feel lived-in.

### What you get
- 🪶 **A bird feeder you mount like a bell** — stand it on the ground, bracket it to a wall, or **hang it under a tree branch**. It even drops if you break what's holding it.
- 🌻 **Different food brings different visitors.** Load it and watch who shows up:
  - **Seeds** → parrots
  - **Flowers** (any kind) → bees
  - **Amethyst shards** → allays
  - The tray even changes colour to match what's inside.
- 💧 **A bird bath** that birds sip and splash in. Fill it with a water bucket — or just let the rain top it up.
- 🕊️ **Calm, random visits.** Birds come every so often, not in a swarm. It's ambience, not a spectacle.
- 🪣 **Hopper-friendly** — pipe seed straight into the feeder, composter-style fill stages and all.

### Crafting

Both blocks craft from cheap, early-game materials.

### Bird Feeder
Three **planks** (any wood) over two **sticks** — a little house on a post.

|        |        |        |
|:------:|:------:|:------:|
| Planks | Planks | Planks |
|        | Stick  |        |
|        | Stick  |        |

### Bird Bath
Five **stone**, basin-shaped.

|       |       |       |
|:-----:|:-----:|:-----:|
| Stone |       | Stone |
| Stone | Stone | Stone |

### Works with your other mods
Visitors are driven by a simple tag (`#birdfeeder:visitors`). Run a mod that adds birds? Drop its entity into that tag (or it does it itself) and those birds start visiting too — **no hard dependency** either way.

### Self-contained
Vanilla + Fabric API only. No libraries to chase.
